title: Penthouse Magazine September 1978 Special Anniversary Issue Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, September 1978 Special Anniversary Issue. Features Pet of the Year Runner-Up Susanne Saxon, "Rock Orgy: 4 on 1," "Defending Jimmy Carter???", "The Happy Unhooker: Getting a Bra Off Before You Get It On," and a reader quiz "Do You Take Advantage of Women?"
Complete issue, no missing pages. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
